method: The document is F-ND1's open set (`tests/test_readings_nd_lean.py`) beside `n` fixed rules spread over 20 extra regulated pairs. Three requests per size: `readings-validate` with every completion `deny` (still the completion's route, whose checks are then trivial, so the author's admission is most of the cost), and `readings-validate` and `readings-elaborate` with unspecified completions. Before review B2 both validates admitted the author's document twice. Each request is sent to two `ve_service` builds, this tree's and the one `--before` names (pinned by its SHA-256; the build lock of this tree need not list it), in turn, and timed as the service process's CPU (every thread's user and system time, `/proc/<pid>/stat`) after one warm-up call; the two builds' answers must be the same.
